title: COMPASS: Routing via Capability-Oriented Model Profiling with Adaptive Search, Selection, and Tool Use
title_zh: COMPASS：基于能力导向模型画像与自适应搜索、选择及工具使用的路由

paragraphs.en: LLM routing aims to select a capable model at low cost, but specialized routers can require updates as models and tasks change. We propose COMPASS , an agentic router in which an LLM follows a routing recipe, gathers performance and cost evidence through tools, and optionally inspects candidate answers before selecting a model. Our evaluations on LLMRouterBench and DeepSWE show that agentic routing can improve accuracy and lower model-call cost relative to specialized and trained routing baselines, without routing-specific training. On LLMRouterBench, COMPASS reaches 69.85% accuracy at $139.57, compared with RLCascadeRouter’s 69.14% at $180.22. On DeepSWE under fixed five-fold cross-validation, it reaches 78.1% at $215, compared with 74.1% at $500 for the best single model. COMPASS also supports routing across benchmarks and adapts to an expanded model pool by reading new evaluation records, without changing the router’s weights or prompt.
paragraphs.zh: LLM路由的目标是以低成本选择有能力胜任的模型，但随着模型和任务的变化，专用路由器可能需要更新。 我们提出COMPASS，一个智能体化路由器，其中LLM遵循路由配方，通过工具收集性能和成本证据，并可在选择模型前选择性地检查候选答案。 我们在LLMRouterBench和DeepSWE上的评估表明，相对于专用路由器和经过训练的路由基线，智能体化路由可以在不进行路由特定训练的情况下提高准确率并降低模型调用成本。 在LLMRouterBench上，COMPASS以139.57美元的成本达到69.85%的准确率，而RLCascadeRouter以180.22美元的成本达到69.14%的准确率。 在固定五折交叉验证的DeepSWE上，它以215美元的成本达到78.1%的准确率，而最佳单一模型以500美元的成本达到74.1%的准确率。 COMPASS还支持跨基准测试的路由，并可通过读取新的评估记录来适应扩展的模型池，而无需更改路由器的权重或提示词。

paragraphs.en: The ecosystem of large language models has fragmented into distinct capability–price tiers. Frontier models dominate benchmarks but are expensive and often slow; small open-weight models are cheap and fast, and for many task distributions they are entirely sufficient. Consider a user requesting a simple Python script: this task does not require a frontier model, and a cost-effective model would complete it at a fraction of the price. The difficulty is that this knowledge is available only in hindsight : one would need to query both the cheap and the frontier model to know whether the cheap model actually sufficed. The routing problem is precisely the problem of estimating this counterfactual before committing to a model.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型的生态系统已经分化为不同的能力—价格层级。 前沿模型在基准测试中占据主导地位，但价格昂贵且通常速度较慢；小型开源权重模型则便宜且快速，对于许多任务分布而言，它们完全足够。 设想一个用户请求编写一个简单的 Python 脚本：这个任务不需要前沿模型，一个高性价比模型只需其价格的一小部分即可完成。 困难在于，这种知识只有在事后才能获得：你需要同时查询便宜模型和前沿模型，才能知道便宜模型是否真的足够。 路由问题正是在选定某个模型之前估计这一反事实的问题。

paragraphs.en: Routing must navigate a three-way trade-off:

paragraphs.en: Cost. Cheaper models reduce per-token spend, but only if they succeed; failed attempts followed by escalation can cost more than routing correctly the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 更便宜的模型能降低每 token 的花费，但前提是它们能成功；失败后升级重试的成本可能高于一开始就正确路由的成本。

paragraphs.en: Latency. A cheap model with low throughput that emits many tokens can take far longer end-to-end than a stronger model that solves the task in substantially fewer tokens. Cost-optimal and latency-optimal choices frequently diverge.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟。 一个吞吐量低但会生成大量 token 的廉价模型，其端到端耗时可能远超一个用少得多的 token 就能完成任务的更强模型。 成本最优与延迟最优的选择经常不一致。

paragraphs.en: Most prior work optimizes a single axis, usually cost reduction at near-constant quality, because cost is the easiest axis to measure and experiment on ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Ong et al., 2025 ) . Optimizing for accuracy instead pushes evaluation toward frontier models, where per-experiment API costs are substantial and public fine-grained evaluation data is scarce.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数已有工作只优化单一维度，通常是在质量近乎恒定的前提下降低成本，因为成本是最容易度量和实验的维度（Chen et al., 2024a；Ong et al., 2025）。 而以准确性为优化目标则会将评估推向前沿模型，其单次实验的 API 成本高昂，且公开的细粒度评估数据十分稀缺。

paragraphs.en: Users can specify what they value without estimating how difficult a query will be. A performance-focused recipe asks the router to prioritize reliable completion; a cost-optimized recipe asks it to seek cheaper configurations when the evidence supports comparable quality. Qualitative levels such as low, medium, or high can express the strength of these preferences. The recipe provides guidelines for gathering evidence and making a decision, while the router assesses the query using that evidence. Numerical trade-off parameters can still be used inside tools and experimental sweeps; users need not tune them for each request.
paragraphs.zh: 用户可以指定他们看重什么，而无需估计查询的难度。 以性能为导向的配方要求路由器优先考虑可靠完成；以成本为优化的配方要求路由器在证据表明质量相当时寻找更便宜的配置。 低、中、高等定性级别可以表达这些偏好的强度。 配方为收集证据和做出决策提供指导，而智能体使用该证据评估查询。 数值权衡参数仍可在工具和实验扫描中使用；用户无需为每个请求调整这些参数。

paragraphs.en: When model-specific performance estimates are encoded in a trained router, changes in the model pool or task distribution can require new supervision or updates. Methods that support unseen models reduce this burden, but still need useful evidence about their capabilities. We instead keep evaluation outcomes in an external corpus that the router can query at inference time. New models can be added by collecting and inserting their evaluation records, without updating the routing agent’s weights. This shifts the maintenance burden to evidence collection, whose cost and coverage remain important limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 当模型特定的性能估计被编码在训练好的路由器中时，模型池或任务分布的变化可能需要新的监督或更新。 支持未见模型的方法可以减轻这一负担，但仍需要关于其能力的有用证据。 我们转而将评估结果保存在一个外部语料库中，路由器可以在推理时查询该语料库。 新模型可以通过收集并插入其评估记录来添加，而无需更新路由智能体的权重。 这将维护负担转移到了证据收集上，而证据收集的成本和覆盖范围仍然是重要的限制。

paragraphs.en: We separate routing knowledge from routing skill . Knowledge about which model scored what, at what cost, and on which task lives in an external evaluation corpus. The skill to query that corpus and decide under a routing recipe comes from the tool-use capabilities of an existing LLM. COMPASS requires no routing-specific weight training: the agent follows the recipe, adaptively explores evidence, and submits a result when it judges the evidence sufficient. This yields three design requirements:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将路由知识与路由技能分离。 关于哪个模型在什么成本下、在哪个任务上取得何种分数的知识，存放在外部的评测语料库中。 查询该语料库并在路由方案下做出决策的技能，来自现有 LLM 的工具使用能力。 COMPASS 不需要任何针对路由的权重训练：智能体遵循方案、自适应地探索证据，并在其判断证据已充分时提交结果。 这带来了三项设计要求：

paragraphs.en: We formulate routing as evidence gathering through tools, separating updatable model records from an existing LLM’s decision-making capabilities (Section 3 ).

paragraphs.en: We implement COMPASS, which follows routing recipes to gather evidence, inspect candidate answers, and select a model or stop unresolved (Section 4 ).

paragraphs.en: One-step routers learn to select a model or execution configuration from preferences and difficulty estimates ( Ong et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2024 ) , predicted performance ( Xue et al., 2026 ; Fernandez et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Zhuang et al., 2024 ) , query–model representations ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Feng et al., 2024 ; Jitkrittum et al., 2026 ) , online feedback ( Panda et al., 2025 ) , or latent expert interactions ( Fein-Ashley et al., 2025 ) . They commit before inspecting a completed answer and therefore cannot revise that query’s route using post-generation evidence. Sequential systems can instead purchase more precise estimates ( Fisch et al., 2026 ) , inspect an answer before stopping or escalating ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Shah and Shridhar, 2025 ; Chuang et al., 2024 ; Dekoninck et al., 2025 ; Gupta et al., 2024 ; Aggarwal et al., 2024 ) , or learn multi-call orchestration ( Nielsen et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2025 ) . Across both families, trained predictors, scorers, and policies may need refreshed outcomes or updates as model pools and task distributions change. Some methods explicitly support new models, but the reliability of transfer across pools remains an empirical question.
paragraphs.zh: 一步式路由器学习从偏好与难度估计（Ong et al., 2025；Ding et al., 2024）、预测性能（Xue et al., 2026；Fernandez et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2024b；Zhuang et al., 2024）、查询–模型表示（Chen et al., 2024b；Feng et al., 2024；Jitkrittum et al., 2026）、在线反馈（Panda et al., 2025）或潜在智能体交互（Fein-Ashley et al., 2025）中选择模型或执行配置。 它们在查看完整答案之前就做出决策，因此无法利用生成后的证据来修正该查询的路由。 序贯系统则可以购买更精确的估计（Fisch et al., 2026），在停止或升级之前检查答案（Chen et al., 2024a；Shah and Shridhar, 2025；Chuang et al., 2024；Dekoninck et al., 2025；Gupta et al., 2024；Aggarwal et al., 2024），或学习多次调用的编排（Nielsen et al., 2026；Shao et al., 2025）。 对于这两类系统，随着模型池和任务分布的变化，经过训练的预测器、评分器和策略可能需要更新结果或进行更新。 一些方法明确支持新模型，但跨模型池迁移的可靠性仍是一个经验性问题。

paragraphs.en: Training-free routers reuse stored query–model outcomes without fitting a dedicated neural policy. The Avengers, Avengers-Pro, and UniRoute’s k-means variant summarize model performance in prompt clusters ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Jitkrittum et al., 2026 ) . Nearest-neighbor variants in RouterBench and CARROT, together with benchmark-based and online kNN routers, transfer observed success or inference-cost estimates from similar evaluated queries ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Shnitzer et al., 2023 ; Somerstep et al., 2025 ; Li, 2025 ; Wu and Silwal, 2025 ) . Eagle blends global and local Elo rankings ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , while ProxRouter reweights nearby evidence to improve outlier robustness ( Patel et al., 2025 ) . The quality of these estimates depends on the coverage and relevance of stored examples: when neighbors are sparse, noisy, or close in embedding space yet different in difficulty or required capability, local model rankings can be unstable or misleading. Global rankings and proximity weights can reduce this risk, but a weakly supported query may still require other evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 免训练路由器复用已存储的查询–模型结果，而无需拟合专门的神经策略。 Avengers、Avengers-Pro 以及 UniRoute 的 k-means 变体在提示簇中汇总模型性能（Zhang 等，2025b；Zhang 等，2025a；Jitkrittum 等，2026）。 RouterBench 和 CARROT 中的最近邻变体，以及基于基准的和在线的 kNN 路由器，将类似已评估查询中观察到的成功或推理成本估计迁移过来（Hu 等，2024；Shnitzer 等，2023；Somerstep 等，2025；Li，2025；Wu 和 Silwal，2025）。 Eagle 融合了全局和局部 Elo 排名（Zhao 等，2024），而 ProxRouter 对邻近证据重新加权以提高对离群点的鲁棒性（Patel 等，2025）。 这些估计的质量取决于已存储示例的覆盖范围和相关性：当邻居稀疏、含噪，或在嵌入空间中相近但在难度或所需能力上不同时，局部模型排名可能不稳定或产生误导。 全局排名和邻近权重可以降低这一风险，但支持薄弱的查询可能仍需要其他证据。

paragraphs.en: These approaches expose two sources of fragility: trainable predictors and policies may require new supervision or retraining as model pools change, and their transfer to unseen pools remains uncertain; neighbor-based training-free estimates can become unreliable when relevant examples are sparse, weakly related, or noisy. COMPASS separates model-specific knowledge from routing skill: outcomes and inference costs reside in an updatable evaluation corpus, while an existing LLM agent uses anonymized model identities to decide which evidence to acquire. Adding a model requires calibration outcomes rather than changes to the agent’s weights. Neighbor retrieval is only one optional evidence tool; the agent can also consult model profiles and quality–cost estimates, inspect a generated answer, request further evidence, or stop unresolved. More informative tools can enrich this search as they become available, provided their inference cost and effect on final-answer reliability are assessed.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法暴露出两个脆弱性来源：可训练的预测器和策略可能随着模型池的变化而需要新的监督或重新训练，并且它们向未见过的模型池的迁移仍不确定；基于邻居的无训练估计在相关示例稀疏、相关性弱或含噪时可能变得不可靠。 COMPASS 将模型特定的知识与路由技能分离开来：结果和推理成本存储在一个可更新的评估语料库中，而一个现有的 LLM 智能体使用匿名化的模型身份来决定获取哪些证据。 添加一个模型只需要校准结果，而不需要更改智能体的权重。 邻居检索只是一种可选的证据工具；该智能体还可以查询模型概况和质量–成本估计、检查生成的答案、请求更多证据，或者在问题未解决时停止。 只要评估了其推理成本以及对最终答案可靠性的影响，更具信息量的工具在可用时可以丰富这一搜索过程。

paragraphs.en: Tools have individual call limits; identical calls are deduplicated, and recipes allow 4–16 calls total. Reading corpus evidence adds no model-call cost. paragraphs.en: Single pick: read reliability or neighbourhood evidence, choose from its accuracy–cost frontier using α \alpha , and submit; one or two calls, no previews.

paragraphs.en: Conditional preview: allow all evidence sources, but enable previews only under preset conditions, such as tied leaders, conflicting evidence, or benchmark diagnostics.

paragraphs.en: Our main routing evaluations use three sources. LLMRouterBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) provides pre-collected per-prompt, per-model results for thirteen models across ten benchmarks: AIME ( Mathematical Association of America, n.d. ) , ArenaHard ( Li et al., 2024 ) , GPQA ( Rein et al., 2023 ) , Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) ( Phan et al., 2025 ) , LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2024 ) , LiveMathBench ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , SimpleQA ( Wei et al., 2024 ) , SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) , and τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench (TAU2) ( Barres et al., 2025 ) . We use its released record dump with the performance–cost configuration’s filters. It is also the corpus used for our head-to-head baseline comparison. Its main limitation is that it contains one record per prompt and model : there are no repeated trials, so pass@ k k and per-task variance cannot be measured.

paragraphs.en: DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) and TerminalBench ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) publish traces. Their repeated trials per cell (four on DeepSWE) make the pass@ k k and ceiling analysis in § 5.5 possible, since we can split trials into disjoint evidence and evaluation sets. The traces also let the router inspect what a model did rather than only whether it passed. Our DeepSWE catalog contains 31 617 31\,617 trials over 113 tasks and 28 model/effort configurations. The paired TerminalBench cohort contains 66 tasks on an exact 18-configuration roster.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSWE（Huang 等，2026）和 TerminalBench（Merrill 等，2026）发布了轨迹。 它们在每个单元格中重复多次试验（DeepSWE 上为四次），使得 §5.5 中的 pass@ k k 与上限分析成为可能，因为我们可以将试验拆分为互不相交的证据集和评估集。 这些轨迹还让路由器能够检视模型做了什么，而不仅仅看它是否通过。 我们的 DeepSWE 目录包含 31 617 31\,617 次试验，覆盖 113 个任务和 28 种模型/努力程度配置。 配对的 TerminalBench 队列包含 66 个任务，对应精确的 18 种配置名单。

paragraphs.en: Routing helps only when different models are reliably better on different tasks. To estimate this opportunity, we use repeated trials on DeepSWE and FrontierSWE: one group of trials selects a model, and a disjoint group evaluates it. Across 60 random splits, we compare selection using evidence from the target task itself, the most behaviorally similar other task, and a random task against always using the best single model.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当不同模型在不同任务上确实更可靠地表现更好时，路由才有帮助。 为了估计这一机会空间，我们在 DeepSWE 和 FrontierSWE 上使用重复试验：一组试验用于选择模型，另一组不相交的试验用于评估它。 在 60 次随机划分中，我们比较了三种选择方式——使用目标任务本身的证据、行为上最相似的其他任务的证据，以及随机任务的证据——与始终使用最佳单一模型的表现。

This suggests useful routing opportunities, but only part of that opportunity is accessible through related tasks. On FrontierSWE, neither approach beats the best single model, leaving little measured benefit from per-task selection.

paragraphs.en: The point is to distinguish apparent oracle gains from gains a router can actually recover. Choosing and scoring a model on the same outcomes exaggerates the opportunity by selecting lucky trials. LLMRouterBench has only one record per task and model, so it cannot support this disjoint-trial check; its oracle gap alone is not evidence of achievable routing gains.

The routing model, prompt, and policy remain fixed: COMPASS adopts the new models directly from their records, without retraining.

These single-run comparisons show small, opposite changes, with no consistent accuracy benefit from revealing model identities.

paragraphs.en: Names nevertheless affect the choices: Luna changes 19% of its selections, compared with 6% for DeepSeek. Both shift slightly toward GPT-5, whose selection share rises from 35.7% to 37.8% for Luna and from 33.6% to 34.1% for DeepSeek. This suggests that model-specific priors can influence routing even when aggregate accuracy barely changes. Anonymization removes explicit model names as a cue for memorized reputation or flagship preference, encouraging decisions based on the supplied evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，名称仍会影响选择：Luna 有 19% 的选择发生变化，而 DeepSeek 仅为 6%。 两者的选择都略微偏向 GPT-5，其被选比例对 Luna 而言从 35.7% 升至 37.8%，对 DeepSeek 而言从 33.6% 升至 34.1%。 这表明即使总体准确率几乎没有变化，模型特定的先验也可能影响路由。 匿名化消除了显式的模型名称这一可能引发记忆中的声誉或旗舰偏好的线索，促使智能体基于所提供的证据做出决策。

paragraphs.en: Because these LLMs have not been trained for our routing objective, they can interpret the same cost–accuracy preference differently. On DeepSWE with fixed five-fold CV, it reaches 68.4% at $105, compared with Luna’s 78.1% at $215. Router choice thus matters more in this setting: lower model-call spend can come with a substantial accuracy loss.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation cost and coverage. Collecting per-task outcomes and trajectories across models is expensive. Routing quality depends on the coverage, reliability, and relevance of those records. Adding a model requires new evidence even though it does not require retraining the agent, and sparse or mismatched data can lead to poor choices.
paragraphs.zh: 评估成本与覆盖范围。 跨模型收集每个任务的结果与轨迹成本高昂。 路由质量取决于这些记录的覆盖范围、可靠性与相关性。 新增一个模型需要新的证据，尽管不需要重新训练智能体，而稀疏或不匹配的数据可能导致糟糕的选择。

paragraphs.en: Distribution-dependent routing. Different task distributions have different routing profiles, and the same router does not perform best across all datasets. Strong results on one cohort do not establish reliable transfer to another.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖分布的路由。 不同的任务分布具有不同的路由特征，同一个路由器并非在所有数据集上都表现最佳。 在一个群体上的强劲结果并不能证明能够可靠地迁移到另一个群体。

DeepSWE estimates have wide confidence intervals, and most experiments use one routing realization per task. The reported task-bootstrap intervals therefore do not capture all routing stochasticity.
paragraphs.zh: 路由开销与不确定性。 智能体推理可能会抵消选择更便宜模型所带来的节省。 DeepSWE 的估计值具有较宽的置信区间，且大多数实验对每个任务仅使用一种路由实现。 因此，报告的任务自举区间并未涵盖所有的路由随机性。

paragraphs.en: COMPASS uses an existing LLM to follow routing recipes and adaptively gather evidence from an updatable evaluation corpus. This separation lets new models be incorporated without retraining the routing agent. Experiments on LLMRouterBench and DeepSWE demonstrate useful accuracy–cost tradeoffs, while the routing-cost analysis and cross-benchmark transfer results show that gains depend on both the evidence and the task distribution.
paragraphs.zh: COMPASS 使用现有的 LLM 遵循路由方案，并从一个可更新的评测语料库中自适应地收集证据。 这种分离使得新模型可以在不重新训练路由智能体的情况下被纳入。 在 LLMRouterBench 和 DeepSWE 上的实验展示了实用的准确率–成本权衡，同时路由成本分析和跨基准迁移结果表明，收益同时取决于证据和任务分布。

paragraphs.en: A next step is cache-aware multi-turn routing, in which the router revisits its decision as a session reveals more about the task. Switching models can incur fresh context-processing costs and lose caching benefits, so a useful policy must weigh these costs against the expected benefit of continuing, switching, or delegating a subtask. Evaluating such policies requires session trajectories with recorded switching decisions, outcomes, and costs. Constructing and evaluating this data is future work; the present experiments address individual tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步是缓存感知的多轮路由，即路由器随着会话揭示更多任务信息而重新审视其决策。 切换模型可能产生新的上下文处理成本并失去缓存收益，因此有效的策略必须权衡这些成本与继续、切换或委派子任务所带来的预期收益。 评估此类策略需要包含已记录的切换决策、结果和成本的会话轨迹。 构建和评估此类数据是未来工作；当前实验针对的是单个任务。
